activity.notes: Dunama II Dibalemi (also spelled Dabbalemi/Dibbalemi) was a major Sayfawa mai during the thirteenth-century Kanem phase of the Kanem-Bornu polity. Modern chronologies disagree substantially over his reign boundaries; 1221-1259 is a widely used reconstruction, so ATLAS records both boundaries as approximate rather than falsely exact.

sources.title: Mai Dunama Dibbalemi — EBSCO Research Starters
sources.citation_text: EBSCO identifies Mai Dunama Dibbalemi as ruler of Kanem and gives 1221-1259 as his reign, while broader scholarship preserves competing chronologies.
